title: How RD Pipeline Keeps Field and Office in Sync with Agave's Procore-Foundation Integration
summary: RD Pipeline uses Agave ERP Sync to connect Procore and Foundation, saving 6+ hours of weekly manual work and giving PMs current job cost visibility.
body_markdown:
## About RD Pipeline Construction


RD Pipeline Construction has been building site utilities in the Denver metro area since 1985. The Arvada, Colorado, family business was founded by the father of Dan Ross, the company's current president. It specializes in water mains and services, sanitary sewer, and storm sewer, primarily for commercial work. RD Pipeline's portfolio includes projects at Denver International Airport's concourse expansions, the Anschutz and Lutheran medical campuses, and municipal and recreational facilities across the metro area.


The company employs between 60 and 70 people, most of them in the field, with about 10 in the office. Since 2018, RD Pipeline has grown from four pipe crews to seven or eight, with more project managers to match. That growth put real pressure on a lean back office where everyone wears several hats. HR Manager Catherine Nevius, who took on IT responsibilities around 2020 and later earned a master's degree in IT management, now assists with the company's digital integration day to day.


## The Challenge: Field and Office Weren't Connected


Since before 2017, RD Pipeline has been working to improve the efficiency and accuracy of data moving between the field and the office. The company adopted technology platforms that moved handwritten jobsite paperwork, most of it safety related, to digital.


What it hadn't found was a platform that connected its project management processes to both the field and the accounting department without an extensive amount of work to set up and maintain. The project management module in Foundation, the company's accounting system, was still being built out at the time and created manual work of its own: every week, an admin had to go project by project to sync labor hours, at least an hour of her week.


RD Pipeline decided to move project management to Procore, but the move only made sense if Procore and Foundation could share data reliably. With no one available to monitor and re-key data between systems, records would get missed or synced late, and a new system that got bogged down would simply stop being used.


## Choosing Agave: Closing the Gap Mid-Rollout


As RD Pipeline committed to Procore, Catherine and CFO Amanda Woods attended Foundation's user conference, where they met the Agave team.


Automatic, scheduled syncing between Procore and Foundation, combined with the ability to review exactly what moves between the two systems, stood out right away. When the team weighed its options, the difference was clear, and they brought Agave on to run alongside their Procore rollout.


## Implementation: Built Around How RD Pipeline Works


Standing up Procore took significant time and training, and RD Pipeline added Procore's financial tools partway through, which changed what could sync. Through all of it, Catherine says, Agave was the easiest part. Vendors, customers, projects, cost codes, and budget items began syncing so Procore stayed set up without anyone re-keying it.


“I don't think we'd be anywhere near where we are in Procore without having Agave, because we were able to sync data easily and focus on the processes within Procore.”


Catherine Nevius


HR Manager, RD Pipeline Construction


Rather than handing over a one-size-fits-all setup, the Agave team asked how RD Pipeline works, what it needs, and how best to configure the integration for the business. Agave's Customer Solutions Engineer explained not only the connections themselves but why data moves the way it does and what can and can't be done. Detailed in-app error guidance usually spells out how to resolve an issue, and when it doesn't, the error message is clear enough that support can answer quickly. The result is a team that understands and manages its integration instead of hoping it works in the background.


## The Impact


“Seriously, I can't imagine not having Agave. It saves us time. It's peace of mind.”


Catherine Nevius


HR Manager, RD Pipeline Construction


###### Hours of Manual Entry Off the Table


The weekly labor-hour sync the admin used to run by hand is gone. Catherine estimates that without Agave she would spend at least two more hours every week entering vendor and other records across systems, on top of the admin's time.


###### Current Job Cost Visibility for Project Managers


Job costs and direct costs now flow automatically from Foundation into Procore, and turning that sync on took the push of a button. The result is what RD Pipeline most wanted for its project managers: a current view of where each job stands. Without it, Catherine says, the budget in Procore would barely matter, and the AP team would be rebuilding the picture in spreadsheets, about three hours a week of work, by her estimate.


Change orders have improved too. Instead of chains of emails and outdated spreadsheets, the team can see what links to what and what still needs to be done.


###### Errors Caught Before They Hit the Books


“When it doesn't get pushed, there's usually a reason, and it's something important that we need to fix on somebody's end. So Agave actually helps catch a lot of miscommunications or errors before they even get into the systems.”


Catherine Nevius


HR Manager, RD Pipeline Construction


Flagged syncs usually point to budget lines or direct costs coded to something that isn't set up correctly. The team has used them to clean up issues like vendors that should have defaulted to job costing but didn't.


###### Easy Enough for the Whole Team


Four RD Pipeline team members have access. Catherine handles most of the work, but other team members who are not in the system every day are comfortable pushing a vendor ahead of the automatic sync and reviewing errors. A project manager has also stepped in to troubleshoot when others were out.


## Looking Ahead: Growing with Agave


RD Pipeline is preparing to add Agave's Workforce module, bringing employee updates and timesheets into the sync, which Catherine expects to be a huge help.


She would recommend Agave without hesitation to other utility subcontractors running Procore and Foundation.


“The most important part is the peace of mind that the data is moved correctly. Knowing that it's up to date immediately saves a lot of time. Agave makes my life a thousand times easier.”


Catherine Nevius


HR Manager, RD Pipeline Construction
